title: Let the Redeemed of the Lord Say So

questions.question: Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:1 (ESV): "Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!"

questions.question: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he has redeemed from what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:2 (ESV): "...whom he has redeemed from trouble"

questions.question: Some wandered in desert wastes, finding no way to a city to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:4 (ESV): "...finding no way to a city to dwell in."

questions.question: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted within them. Then they cried to the Lord in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:6 (ESV): "Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble,"

questions.question: He delivered them from their distress. He led them by a straight way till they reached a city to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:7 (ESV): "...till they reached a city to dwell in."

questions.question: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wondrous works to the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:8 (ESV): "...for his wondrous works to the children of man!"

questions.question: For he satisfies the longing soul, and the hungry soul he fills with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:9 (ESV): "...and the hungry soul he fills with good things."

questions.question: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and what?
For they had rebelled against the words of God, and spurned the counsel of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:11 (ESV): "...and spurned the counsel of the Most High."

questions.question: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and burst their bonds in what?
Some were fools through their sinful ways, and because of their iniquities suffered what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:17 (ESV): "...and because of their iniquities suffered affliction."

questions.question: They loathed any kind of food, and they drew near to the gates of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:18 (ESV): "...and they drew near to the gates of death."

questions.question: He sent out his word and healed them, and delivered them from their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:20 (ESV): "...and delivered them from their destruction."

questions.question: Some went down to the sea in ships, doing business on the great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:23 (ESV): "...doing business on the great waters;"

questions.question: He turns a desert into pools of water, a parched land into springs of water. And there he lets the hungry do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 107:35-36 (ESV): "...And there he lets the hungry dwell,"

key_verse_text: Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!
